ios.desc:
You used to be a reader. Then the feed got louder, the days got busier, and the books stopped opening. You didn't lose the love of reading — you just lost the moment to read.

bookFolks is the book tracker that helps you get back into reading — without pressure, without guilt, and without turning your favorite hobby into homework.

Meet Folks, a little fox who reads alongside you and celebrates every page you turn. One chapter is a win. One page is a win. Showing up is the whole point — not hitting a number.

HOW BOOKFOLKS BRINGS READING BACK
- Track your books and progress — a simple reading tracker that keeps your current reads in one cozy place.
- Build your TBR — every book you want to read, ready when you are, without the overwhelm.
- Organize your bookshelf — finished books stack up, and small milestones are worth celebrating.
- Find your next read — the right book, not just another rec, so you never stall between books.
- Read at your own speed — no goals to fail, no catching up, no guilt.

MADE FOR BOOK LOVERS
Whether you found us on BookTok, live for your TBR, or just miss being a reader, bookFolks is built for the way you actually read. Track your reading, write quick book reviews, join the book club conversation, and watch your reading life grow — one page at a time.

WHY READERS LOVE BOOKFOLKS
- Free, simple, and beautiful — no ads, no clutter.
- A companion, not a chore — the friendliest book tracker to help you read more.
- Readers who join read 4x more on average — because reading started feeling good again.

Whether you're coming back after years away, climbing out of a reading slump, or just want to read more books without the pressure, bookFolks helps you turn one more page — today.

Download bookFolks free and get back into reading.

Hey there,

I am building an app to help people incorporate books into their daily routine on Android and IOS. The goal is to let users track their reading, their books, win prizes and ultimately reinforce their reading habit.

Can you give me some feedback about the features necessary for such an app?

Thank you :)
